declared_by: Claude (system track), on the user's instruction of 2026-11-02 ("做 E2 和轻量版 E5")
authority: docs/fyp2/03_EVALUATION_COVERAGE_MATRIX.md (E2 and E5 sections, and the 2026-10-22 addendum)

D06 user decision of 2026-10-23: artificial vision + telemetry pairs are constructed evaluation scenarios; the operational reference policy is declared in advance; report complementarity and attenuation
prohibited_inferences: No fusion weight is selected as 'best' from these results.
No RiskScore or RiskLevel result is evidence of real-world risk-prediction accuracy or accident prevention.
Agreement with the operational reference is agreement with a policy declared here, not with ground-truth severity.
A smaller score change under fusion is arithmetic, not evidence of safer prediction.

operational_reference_policy.basis: The SOURCE dataset labels of the two branches only (State Farm class id; Driver_Behavior behavior_label). It is fixed here, before any result is seen, and it never reads a model output or the fusion formula.

fixed_runtime.vision_model: the active stable model (DRA_ACTIVE_VISION unset = stable MobileNetV3-Large); identity recorded from GET /api/models
fixed_runtime.telemetry_model: the stable XGBoost; identity recorded from GET /api/models
fixed_runtime.pipeline: the real POST /api/sessions/{id}/infer through fastapi.testclient.TestClient, a temporary SQLite and an injected clock; no port 8000, never backend/driver_risk.db*

e2.name: E2 normal-input fusion behaviour and weight sensitivity
e2.sampling: Each pool is sorted (vision by filename, telemetry by row index). random.Random(seed).sample draws, without replacement, 30 safe images, 30 distracted images, 20 Safe rows, 20 Aggressive rows and 20 Distracted rows, in that order. They are handed out in stratum order (S1..S6), 10 per stratum, so no image and no telemetry row is used twice. Image i of a stratum is paired with row i.
e2.unit_of_execution: one new LIVE_MODEL_RUNTIME session per (pair, weight) with exactly one /infer window (first observation, so no EMA history), image = original JPEG bytes, telemetry = the source row's eight features
metrics: formula_error: the product RiskScore minus an independent exact-arithmetic recomputation (fractions.Fraction) from the returned fused probabilities and the weights; the expected bound is the 0.05 rounding half-step
probability consistency: the returned probabilities are identical across the five weights for the same pair
RiskScore distribution per stratum x weight (min, q1, median, q3, max)
RiskLevel counts per stratum x weight
agreement with the operational reference per stratum x weight
level change against the 0.5/0.5 baseline per pair (count and direction)
DominantEvidence counts per stratum x weight
raw-strength vs weighted-contribution disagreement (R14): DominantEvidence is Vision-dominant while w_t*P_t > w_v*P_v, or Telemetry-dominant while w_v*P_v > w_t*P_t
attenuation cases: one branch >= 0.8 and the other < 0.2, with the fused level below High
branch-model disagreement with the source label (vision P >= 0.5 vs class_id != c0; telemetry P >= 0.5 vs label != Safe), reported separately so a model error is not read as a fusion effect

e5_light.name: E5 (light) single-branch counterfactuals on the viva_compact constructed scenario

variants.change: every segment's vision_class set to c0; telemetry labels unchanged (only telemetry varies)
every segment's telemetry_label set to Safe; vision classes unchanged (only vision varies)

e5_light.variant_identity: Each variant is built with scripts/build_dataset_replay.build_bundle, same seed and same segment order and durations, so a segment whose labels did not change gets byte-identical frames and telemetry rows.

timeline.telemetry_seq: starts at 0 and grows by 1 each time k grows (ai/src/scenarioTimeline.ts)

e5_light.session: one CONSTRUCTED_SCENARIO_RUNTIME session per variant, default weights 0.5/0.5, replay block attached as the app does
e5_light.reference: per window, the operational_reference_policy applied to the window's source labels; segment expectations follow from it (Baseline REF_LOW, Telemetry only REF_ELEVATED, Telemetry wavers REF_LOW, Vision only REF_ELEVATED, Both REF_HIGH, Recovery REF_LOW)
metrics: per segment and variant: windows, RiskScore mean / max / last, RiskLevel counts, DominantEvidence counts, highest AlertSeverity, agreement with the reference
lag: time from a segment's start to the first window whose RiskLevel is in the segment's reference set
branch contribution: FUSED minus each held variant, per window, summarised per segment
attenuation: in segments where exactly one branch is non-safe, the smoothed branch probability next to the fused RiskScore
